newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close firmer in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close firmer in thin trade.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks closed a shade stronger in thin trading on Tuesday, with sellers seeking hefty premiums, brokers said.
The all share index closed 0.91 points higher at 559.01.
Brokers said many big buyers were stymied by a lack of shares.
"There is buying of stock like Haycarb which is export oriented," said Alistair Corera of brokerge Forbes & Walker. "But since there are no sellers you have to pay a premium to find quantity."
Haycar rose three rupees to 95 and Hayleys two rupees to 185.
Brokers said they saw foreign and local demand for a number of shares which had posted good first quarter and six-month results.
"Sellers want big premiums but there is a limit to which the buyers are willing to go," said Corera.
Turnover was a low 3.79 million rupees on 201,808 shares.
